title: 054 The Power of Predictive Analytics in Higher Education: Insights with Emily Chase Coleman
summary: Emily's company is dedicated to helping colleges and universities optimize their enrollment and financial aid strategies through predictive modeling, ensuring that these institutions meet their goals while maintaining financial sustainability. Emily shares her background in social psychology and statistics and how she got into the field of enrollment management and predictive modeling. Sher and Emily discuss the types of data that institutions collect, including application data, financial data, and student behavior data.
